flags.problem: '100% on Game of 24' is uncited in the README with no method (WebFetch-verified). The 4%/36% baselines are uncited too. Never stitch.
The E3 conditions A/B/C are undefined on the README (verified), so '95.3% vs 93.8%, 63% of tokens' means nothing to a viewer.

'94% handed back' comes from JEV-works' all-signals-confident gate. The film sets it beside the jev score_fill τ thresholds, which belong to a different system. The τ numbers are also unfeelable units on screen.
'Citation audit · 47 of 60 faithful' is the p5 atlas memory-graph audit, not OmniMemory. The number is misattributed.
Showing 'Verus 81% · DafnyBench 92.7%' on screen implies AI routinely produces formal proofs, and it puts proof/Lean terms in a gate context (RESEARCH §2 cautions).
The caption 'It proved itself' uses proof language for a mechanical check (RESEARCH §2). Reword to 'It caught it. Now it stops it.' before stitching.
'What stays put is conserved' conflates a fixed point under rotation with a conserved quantity. That muddles the Noether analogy RESEARCH §4 warns about.
'Trust what fits its neighbours', together with the mechanism 'the made-up part stands out', implies agreement detects fabrication. That contradicts 'consistency ≠ truth'.
It pictures a working caption-ownership gate, but R1/G7 is proposed and not built (sb-10-03's own case says so). Mark it Illustration or proposed.
A near-empty page 'passes every pin', yet the same case cites a real 'stubs 0' gate that targets exactly that. The film contradicts itself; make it a thin non-stub page.
Of the 'seven gates', contact_sheet is 'PASS — reviewed', a human review. The Notion page does not attribute the 3 fixes to specific gates. Do not call all seven machine checks.
Not an error, a caution: GREEN is the engine's own verdict, and the 9 spine atoms are still Draft per the Context Atoms page. Never caption them 'verified'.
Caution: 548 = 437 + 107 lab + 4 hubs, and 47/60 is the atlas's audit, while the lab delta is unaudited. The limit card must say 'atlas citation audit'.
The 30/30 binary gates are a build audit. They do not evidence the join-discord mechanism the film shows (capability mismatch).
The README run shows 'Cycles Found: 0', but the film's move is finding a loop. The case does not show the move.
The 9 red CI runs have no recorded cause, and none shows the gate catching a bad file, so the case does not evidence the move.
The README says 'Writes stay parked'. 'Sending mail … unless explicitly enabled' is not verified wording.
